extension.description: LaTeX structure colors, compiled numbers, listing line numbers and delimiter warnings.
command.applyCodeTextColor: LaTeX: Apply Embedded Code Text Color
config.codeBackground: Add a subtle code-block background while retaining syntax colors.
config.showNumbers: Display numbers from the last compilation above source lines.
config.listingLineNumbers: Preview literal lstlisting numbering options in the current file.
config.auxFile: Compiled root AUX path; absolute or relative to the workspace.
config.language: Language of runtime hints and prompts. Settings and command labels follow the VS Code display language.
config.colorScheme: Highlight palette; auto follows the editor light/dark appearance.
config.colors: Override individual palette colors with #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA.
